purpose: Use already-consumed DEV2000 A+B only to test whether a 3-5 races/day target requires lowering a confidence threshold and to separate winner-probability behavior from ticket-probability behavior. This is a historical diagnostic, not validation of the current S0 model.
legacy_model_scope_warning: Candidate_A and B1a_RECONSTITUTED_v1 are historical models. Their probabilities are not asserted to be identical to the current S0_SCORE_ONLY_SOFTMAX plus rider/style/circumference challenger. Therefore these numbers are design evidence only, not current-model calibration evidence.

top1_agreement_frequency_diagnostic.interpretation: In this broad historical all-venue universe, even the 0.40 legacy agreement gate supplied far more than 3-5 races/day on average. This argues against lowering a threshold solely to manufacture frequency. It does not prove the current model will have the same coverage.

daily_topn_blind_3renhuku_diagnostic.selection_analogue: Require historical Candidate_A/B1a same top1 and same unordered top3 set; rank eligible races within each calendar date by conservative top1 probability; stake flat 100 yen on the common top3 3renhuku ticket. No price/value filtering is applied in this diagnostic.
daily_topn_blind_3renhuku_diagnostic.interpretation: A daily Top3/Top5 sporting rank by itself did not produce positive historical economics. Candidate frequency and purchase frequency must remain separate; a pre-price value veto is still necessary.

bridge_to_existing_burned_ticket_calibra.known_finding: Historical high-odds 3rentan selections were strongly overconfident conditional on model-market disagreement, even while winner-probability behavior can show a different calibration direction.
bridge_to_existing_burned_ticket_calibra.consequence: Top1 calibration cannot substitute for ticket-level calibration. The current 3renhuku <=20x path needs its own current-model ticket-probability audit before profitability claims.

decision_implications: Preserve the strict 0.40 lane as a scientific control; do not lower it merely to meet daily frequency.
Prefer ranking a broad daily race universe and producing 3-5 candidates, then applying a separate pre-price value veto.
Do not interpret daily Top3/Top5 selection alone as an edge; the burned diagnostic was negative at both 3 and 5 bets/day.
Run direct current-model top1 and 3renhuku-ticket calibration on allowed burned A+B only if current S0 inputs can be reconstructed without touching Segment C.
Evaluate future evidence on 7-day, 30-day and 90-day horizons with drawdown, losing streak and winner-concentration checks.
